verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a unified API that includes embeddings alongside chat/image/audio (together-ai-docs-21), supporting retrieval pipelines without a separate embeddings vendor. However, no evidence in the pack documents a dedicated rerank endpoint or reranking models, so the reranking half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: dedicated rerank API/model documentation, embeddings model list/dimensions, and independent confirmation of embeddings quality/usage in RAG pipelines.
